rec.name: Complaints Americans filed against banks
rec.what: Complaints Americans filed against banks, credit card companies, debt collectors and mortgage servicers, to the federal consumer finance watchdog.
rec.means: This date is the day it arrived with the agency — when it was reported, which can be long after it happened.
rec.subject: Consumer Protection
rec.shape: How many per month, 15 years of it

why: The cleanest big harm series you own. Seventeen million people complaining about banks, card companies and debt collectors, every month since late 2011, still running today.

rec.name: Every shipment of prescription opioids in America from...
rec.what: Every shipment of prescription opioids in America from 2006 to 2012 - manufacturer to distributor to pharmacy, pill by pill. The dataset behind the opioid litigation.
rec.means: This date is the day the pills were shipped — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Health

why: Every prescription opioid pill shipped in America, 2006 to 2012. The rise is right there in the line, and so is the exact point the record stops.

rec.name: Every mine in the United States
rec.what: Every mine in the United States, who operates it, and whether it is still active.
rec.means: This date is the current status date — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Labor
rec.shape: How many per month, across 101 years

why: Mine openings and closures back to 1925. The coal decline shows up as a shape rather than an argument — and it is the denominator for the violations below.

rec.name: Every safety violation a federal inspector wrote up at a...
rec.what: Every safety violation a federal inspector wrote up at a US mine, and the fine that followed.
rec.means: This date is the violation issue date — when an authority ruled on it.
rec.subject: Labor
rec.shape: How many per month, 32 years of it

why: Every safety violation an inspector wrote in a mine, 32 years of it. Worth watching next to the mine count, not on its own.

rec.name: Every problem inspectors found in a US nursing home
rec.what: Every problem inspectors found in a US nursing home, and how serious they judged it.
rec.means: This date is the day inspectors visited the nursing home — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Health

why: Every problem inspectors found in a nursing home. Handle with care: the raw count rose 446 times, but almost all of that was more homes being inspected. Per home it was 62%.

rec.name: Every US bank that has failed
rec.what: Every US bank that has failed, and the date it was shut down.
rec.means: This date is the day it failed — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Economics
rec.shape: How many per month, across 56 years

why: Only 3,584 rows and 56 years, and the 2008–10 spike does all the work. The smallest interesting series in here.

rec.name: Medical devices cleared for sale on the grounds that they...
rec.what: Medical devices cleared for sale on the grounds that they resemble something already on the market.
rec.means: This date is the day it arrived with the agency — when it was reported, which can be long after it happened.
rec.subject: Health
rec.shape: How many per month, across 50 years

why: Every medical device cleared for sale since 1976 on the grounds that it resembles something already on the market. Fifty unbroken years of the approval curve.

rec.name: The retracted scientific papers database
rec.what: The retracted scientific papers database, a second cut.
rec.means: This date is the original paper date — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Science Research
rec.shape: How many per month, across 273 years

why: Retracted scientific papers per year. The line climbs hard — whether that is more fraud or more catching is the actual question, and you can see both.

rec.name: People killed by US police
rec.what: People killed by US police, documented by an independent project.
rec.means: This date is the incident month day year — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Justice
rec.shape: How many per month, 13 years of it

why: Everyone killed by US police since 2013, month by month. A complete decade with no gaps.

rec.name: Every company registered in the United Kingdom
rec.what: Every company registered in the United Kingdom.
rec.means: This date is the day the company was legally created — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Corporate Registry
rec.shape: How many per month, across 325 years

why: Nearly six million companies with birth dates going back to 1701. Company births per year, deaths per year, and how old the surviving ones are — three different charts from one table.

rec.name: People and firms paid to represent foreign governments and...
rec.what: People and firms paid to represent foreign governments and interests inside the United States, as they are legally required to declare.
rec.means: This date is the date on the record — when it was reported, which can be long after it happened.
rec.subject: Foreign Influence
rec.shape: How many per month, across 84 years

why: Who registered to lobby the US government on behalf of a foreign one, 1942 to today. Small and clean, and the mix of countries moves with history.

rec.name: Money flowing into the US Treasury each day
rec.what: Money flowing into the US Treasury each day — the government's daily bank statement, deposits side.
rec.means: This date is the day the record was written — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Economics
rec.shape: How many per month, 21 years of it

why: Money flowing into the US Treasury every single day for 21 years. Tax deadlines show up as walls.

rec.name: Every reported donation an individual made to a federal...
rec.what: Every reported donation an individual made to a federal political campaign — donor name, employer, amount and date.
rec.means: This date is the day the money moved — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Finance
rec.shape: How many per month, 26 years of it

why: Eighty-four million individual political donations since 2000. Per election cycle, by donation size, and how many land on suspiciously round numbers.

rec.name: Every recorded earthquake
rec.what: Every recorded earthquake - where, when and how strong.
rec.means: This date is the moment it was recorded — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Science
rec.shape: How many per month, 16 years of it

why: Every recorded earthquake since 2010. A caution as much as a series: it measures how well we detect as much as how much the ground moves.

rec.name: People and companies under sanctions
rec.what: People and companies under sanctions, on watchlists, or flagged as politically exposed, worldwide.
rec.means: This date is the day the person was born — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Justice
rec.shape: How many per month, across 126 years

why: Who got sanctioned, per year, going back to 1900. Watch the designations cluster around the events you already know.

rec.name: Payments and gifts from drug and device companies to...
rec.what: Payments and gifts from drug and device companies to individual doctors and teaching hospitals.
rec.means: This date is the day the payment was made — when the thing itself took place.
rec.subject: Health
rec.shape: How many per month — under two years, so it is a snapshot more than a trend

why: Drug and device company payments and gifts to doctors — 15.4 million of them in 2024 alone. Each year is its own table here, so a long trend needs them stitched together first.
